doc.title: FAQ
doc.summary: This document provides answers to frequently asked questions regarding hostel room allocation, payment processing, and policy management within the Digii campus-management platform, covering both Dues Management and Offline Payment scenarios.

chunks.what_it_does: This feature allows administrators to track the payment status of all students, providing full visibility of payment records, specifically when the Dues Management payment mode is selected.
chunks.why_it_matters: It provides essential visibility into financial records, enabling institutions to monitor student payments effectively and manage outstanding dues.
how_to_use: Ensure Dues Management payment mode is selected.
Access the platform's payment records for full visibility of student payment statuses.
examples: A finance administrator checks the payment status of all students for the current semester to identify outstanding fees.
user_questions: How do I see if students have paid?
Where can I track student payments?
What is Dues Management payment mode?
Can I view all student payment records?
How to check student fee status?

chunks.what_it_does: When a student selects Offline Payment, room allocation is not automatic. The institution must manually confirm the payment externally and then manually allocate rooms within the system.
chunks.why_it_matters: This clarifies the manual process required for offline payments, preventing confusion and ensuring rooms are assigned correctly after external payment verification.
how_to_use: Confirm the offline payment externally (e.g., bank transfer, cash).
Manually allocate rooms to the student in the system.
examples: A student pays their hostel fees via bank transfer. The hostel administrator confirms the payment with the bank and then manually assigns a room in the system.
user_questions: Can I automatically allocate rooms for offline payments?
How to assign rooms after an offline payment?

Does Auto Allotment work with offline payments?
How do I confirm an offline payment?

chunks.feature_name: Multiple Department Selection for Hostel Policy
chunks.what_it_does: The Hostel Administrator can select and apply hostel policies to multiple departments simultaneously using checkboxes under Hostel Policy Options.
chunks.why_it_matters: This feature allows for flexible and comprehensive policy application, enabling institutions to manage hostel rules efficiently across various academic units.
how_to_use: Navigate to Hostel Policy Options.
Use the provided checkboxes to select multiple departments to which the policy should apply.
examples: The Hostel Administrator sets a policy for all first-year engineering and science students by selecting both departments in the Hostel Policy Options.
user_questions: Can I apply a hostel policy to more than one department?
How do I select multiple departments for a hostel policy?
Who can set hostel policies for multiple departments?
Where are Hostel Policy Options?
Is it possible to assign a hostel policy to several departments?

chunks.what_it_does: This feature ensures that room allocation adheres to institutional policies by utilizing Hostel Policy Options with predefined criteria such as gender, batch year, and department.
chunks.why_it_matters: It guarantees fair, consistent, and compliant room assignments, aligning with established institutional guidelines and promoting an organized hostel environment.
how_to_use: Configure Hostel Policy Options.
Define specific criteria such as gender, batch year, and department to guide room allocation.
examples: The institution requires male and female students to be housed in separate blocks. The Hostel Administrator sets a gender-based policy in Hostel Policy Options to enforce this rule during allocation.
user_questions: How do I make sure room allocation follows rules?
What criteria can I use for hostel policies?
Can I set policies for room allocation based on gender?
How to align room assignments with institutional guidelines?
Where do I define room allocation policies?

chunks.what_it_does: This clarifies that Auto Allotment functionality does not apply to Offline Payments. Rooms must be manually allocated once the payment is confirmed externally.
chunks.why_it_matters: It prevents users from expecting automatic room assignments for offline payments, ensuring they understand the manual process required and streamlining operations.
how_to_use: Confirm the offline payment externally.
Manually allocate rooms to the student in the system.
examples: A student makes an offline payment. The system will not automatically assign a room; the administrator must manually assign it after verifying the payment.

synonyms: manual room assignment for offline fees

chunks.what_it_does: Students can check the processing status of their hostel fee payments within the Payments section of the platform, specifically under Dues Management.
chunks.why_it_matters: This provides students with a self-service capability to monitor their financial obligations, reducing inquiries to administrative staff and improving transparency.
how_to_use: Log in to the platform.
Navigate to the Payments section.
Check your payment status under Dues Management.
examples: A student logs into their Digii account to confirm if their hostel fee payment has been successfully processed before the deadline.

chunks.what_it_does: If a student needs to change their room after it has been allocated, they must contact the Hostel Administrator to inquire about availability and request a change, subject to institutional policies.
chunks.why_it_matters: This provides a clear and structured procedure for students needing to adjust their housing, ensuring requests are handled properly and in accordance with hostel rules.
how_to_use: Contact the Hostel Administrator.
Inquire about current room availability.
Submit a formal request for a room change, adhering to institutional policies.
examples: A student realizes they need a different room due to a medical condition. They contact the Hostel Administrator to discuss available options and submit a formal request.

chunks.what_it_does: Students can select their preferred room if the Dues Management payment mode is enabled, allowing them to choose a specific room before making payment.
chunks.why_it_matters: This feature offers students more control over their housing choices, enhancing satisfaction and providing a personalized experience during the hostel allocation process.
how_to_use: Ensure Dues Management is selected for payment.
Browse the list of available rooms.
Select your preferred room.
Proceed with payment to confirm your selection.
examples: A student logs into the platform, sees a list of available rooms, selects a room on the third floor with a window view, and then completes the payment via Dues Management.

chunks.what_it_does: Students can make payments for their hostel fees either through the Dues Management system on the platform (online) or via Offline Payment if enabled by the institution.
chunks.why_it_matters: This provides clear and flexible options for students to fulfill their financial obligations, accommodating different payment preferences and institutional capabilities.
how_to_use: Choose Dues Management on the platform for online payment.
Alternatively, use the Offline Payment method if it has been enabled by the institution.
examples: A student logs in and pays their hostel fees using the Dues Management portal with a credit card. Another student visits the finance office to make an offline payment via cash.

chunks.what_it_does: If Dues Management is selected, a student's room will be automatically allocated once their payment is successfully cleared through the platform.
chunks.why_it_matters: This feature assures students that their room will be secured promptly after successful online payment, providing peace of mind and an efficient allocation process.
how_to_use: Make payment through Dues Management.
Wait for the payment to clear through the platform.
Your room will be automatically allocated upon clearance.
examples: After a student successfully pays their hostel fees via Dues Management, the system immediately assigns them a room based on predefined policies, without further manual intervention.

chunks.feature_name: Room Allocation Delay for Non-Dues Management Payments
chunks.what_it_does: If hostel fees are not paid through Dues Management, room allocation will be delayed until the payment is manually processed and confirmed by the institution.
chunks.why_it_matters: This clarifies the consequences of not using the Dues Management system for payments, encouraging its use for faster allocation and setting proper expectations for alternative methods.
how_to_use: If not using Dues Management, ensure your payment is processed and confirmed externally.
Await manual room allocation after confirmation.
examples: A student makes an offline payment. Their room is not immediately allocated; it will be assigned only after the finance department manually confirms the payment and updates the system, which can take time.
